name: Collapsing Ramp (9-10)
source: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-22: Breaking the Storm: Excising Ruination
description: Abyssal fire hits the stone beneath the ramp, causing a 15-foot-long section of it to collapse.
disable: DC 31 Crafting check (expert) to stabilize the masonry. Each attempt takes 2 actions.

offensiveAbilities.name: Collapse
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature walks onto the collapse site

Effect The triggering creature falls off the Colossus and lands on the ground, taking 50 bludgeoning damage. They can use the Grab an Edge reaction to avoid falling (DC 24 Reflex save).
